title: Airpro Technology India IPO Details
intro:
Airpro Technology India IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹35.64 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 29.20 lakh shares aggregating to ₹28.91 crores and offer for sale of 6.80 lakh shares aggregating to ₹6.73 crores.

Airpro Technology India IPO opens for subscription on Nov 27, 2026 and closes on Dec 1, 2026. The allotment for the Airpro Technology India IPO is expected to be finalized on Dec 2, 2026. Airpro Technology India IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Dec 4, 2026.

Airpro Technology India IPO is set final issue price at ₹99 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,37,600 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,56,400.

Horizon Management Pvt.ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Airpro Technology India IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated on February 17, 2014, Airpro Technology India Limited is a technology-driven company engaged in the design, assembly, distribution and servicing of wired and wireless networking products and solutions. The Company operates as a brand owner, providing networking solutions for enterprises and institutions to establish and manage reliable, scalable and cost-effective connectivity infrastructure. The Company offers a range of networking products, including wireless access points, WLAN controllers, Ethernet switches, gateways, outdoor wireless solutions, 4G/5G Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) and industrial Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches. Its products cater to different deployment environments, including enterprise networks, campuses, industrial facilities and locations requiring wireless broadband connectivity.

In addition to hardware products, the Company provides software-enabled networking solutions through its cloud-based platform, AirproCloud, which enables customers to configure, monitor and manage network infrastructure remotely. The platform supports centralised monitoring of networking devices, bandwidth utilisation, user access controls and network performance analytics and is currently available on Android-based devices. The Company also develops customised firmware for certain white-label products, supporting customer-specific requirements such as user authentication, bandwidth allocation and network access management.

The Company follows a hybrid business model comprising product design, firmware customisation, cloud-based network management, in-house assembly and white-label networking solutions. It markets its products under its own brand through distributors and online channel partners, including e-commerce platforms, and primarily operates through a B2B model. Its customer base spans multiple industry verticals.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 39 permanent employees across management, sales and marketing, software development, legal and secretarial, accounts and finance, IT and technical support, and support functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in Airpro Technology India IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Airpro Technology India IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Airpro Technology India IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Airpro Technology India IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.question: When Airpro Technology India IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Airpro Technology India IPO opens on Fri, Nov 27, 2026 and closes on Tue, Dec 1, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Airpro Technology India IPO?
faqs.answer: Airpro Technology India IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,37,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Airpro Technology India IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Airpro Technology India IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Airpro Technology India IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Airpro Technology India IPO will be done on Wednesday, December 2, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Dec 3, 2026 . Check the Airpro Technology India IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Airpro Technology India IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The tentative date of Airpro Technology India IPO is Fri, Dec 4, 2026 .
